modmenu.descriptionTranslation.qualityes: Quality of life in one mod: food and saturation, what-am-I-looking-at panel, effect timers, armor and tool HUD, dark loading screen and a keyboard map. Every module can be turned off and steps aside for the original mod.
qualityessentials.editor.hint: Drag panels with the mouse. Wheel - size, arrows - nudge (Shift - by 10), Alt - no snapping, Tab - next
qualityessentials.editor.pick: Click a panel to select it
qualityessentials.editor.title: HUD layout
qualityessentials.keyboard.legend.title: Legend
qualityessentials.keyboard.mouse.title: Mouse
qualityessentials.keyboard.panel.conflic: Conflicts: %s. Press Show or click a key on the layout
qualityessentials.keyboard.panel.free: This key is free. Press Change on any binding and click this key on the layout.
qualityessentials.keyboard.panel.hint: Click a key on the layout to see its bindings and rebind them. Hold Ctrl, Shift or Alt to see that modifier layer.
qualityessentials.keyboard.panel.no_conf: No conflicts. Click a key on the layout to see and change its bindings
qualityessentials.keyboard.screen.title: Keyboard map
qualityessentials.keyboard.tooltip.click: Click to see and change bindings
qualityessentials.keyboard.waiting: Press a key or mouse button for "%s". You can click a key on the layout, Esc cancels
qualityessentials.module.dark_screen.des: Removes the red flash on startup and resource pack reloads: the loading background becomes dark.
qualityessentials.module.effects.descrip: Time left and level right on the effect icons in the corner. The color changes when an effect is about to end.
qualityessentials.module.equipment.descr: Durability of armor and held items, arrows for bow and crossbow, total amount of the held block in the whole inventory.
qualityessentials.module.food.descriptio: Gold frames over the hunger bar show saturation. Food in hand flashes on the bar with what it will restore. Food tooltips show hunger and saturation.
qualityessentials.module.keyboard.descri: The whole keyboard with numpad and mouse: bindings on keys, conflicts, Ctrl/Shift/Alt layers and rebinding right on the layout. Default key F10.
qualityessentials.module.look_at.descrip: A panel at the top: the block or creature you aim at, crop growth, redstone power, required tool, breaking progress, health and armor, villager profession, horse speed, source mod.
qualityessentials.module.stats.descripti: An overlay with FPS, ping and TPS. On a server it shows ping and an estimate of server TPS, in singleplayer the real TPS and MSPT of the integrated server.
qualityessentials.option.effects.level.h: II, III and up in the icon corner
qualityessentials.option.effects.timer.h: Time left, color changes near the end
How many arrows while holding a bow or crossbow
qualityessentials.option.equipment.total: For example 448 next to the stone bricks in your hand
qualityessentials.option.food.preview.hi: Held food flashes what it will restore
qualityessentials.option.food.saturation: Gold frames over the hunger bar
qualityessentials.option.keyboard.contro: Keyboard map button in the controls settings
Which tool is needed and whether you hold it
qualityessentials.option.lookat.health.h: Health bar and armor for creatures
qualityessentials.option.lookat.mod.hint: Which mod the block or creature comes from
qualityessentials.option.lookat.progress: A bar at the bottom while breaking a block
qualityessentials.option.lookat.states.h: Growth, power, honey level and more
qualityessentials.option.stats.coords.hi: Hidden when the server enables reduced debug info
How many entities are loaded around
qualityessentials.option.stats.memory.hi: Used and allocated to the game, in GB
qualityessentials.option.stats.mspt.hint: Integrated server tick time, singleplayer only
qualityessentials.option.stats.ping.hint: Latency to the server, servers only
qualityessentials.option.stats.tps.hint: Estimated from world time on servers, exact in singleplayer
qualityessentials.settings.banner.yielde: %s is installed, so this QE module is off to avoid two identical overlays.
qualityessentials.settings.footer: Up and Down switch modules, Esc closes.
